resources.string: Before using anything with consequences, see how Pro CHart handles signals, permissions, external providers and support.

Signal → analysis → entry / stop / targets → execute → monitor → close or target hit → result. Execution always requires an explicit confirmation path, and the app never invents a broker or exchange outcome.
Camera access is requested only when you choose Camera in chart analysis. Gallery selection stays available without it.
Push is not configured for this build, so the app will not request notification permission.
This Android version does not require the runtime notification permission.
Notifications can alert you to the signal and activity updates the server sends. Permission is optional and is requested only after you tap the button below.
Notification permission was denied. Pro CHart still works without it, and you can change this in Android settings at any time.
Notification permission is granted. Delivery still depends on the push service and server state.

Trading and investment carry the risk of loss. Signals, analysis and AI output are not guaranteed outcomes. Execution depends on the external provider, account permissions, market conditions and server confirmation. Past or displayed results do not guarantee future performance. Review every order before confirming it.

A connection configured on the device is not the same as a verified live one. Pro CHart enables provider-dependent actions only from explicit server evidence; missing, stale or failed states stay visible.

This app ships no analytics, advertising or tracking SDK, and reads no location, contacts or advertising id. Your sign-in token is encrypted with a key that never leaves the device and stays on it; signing out clears both the session and the refresh token. Your name and national id are sent only if you complete the identity form, and a chart image only when you send one. A random install id travels with each request so the server’s rate limiter can tell two installs behind one shared IP apart — it is not tied to your account or your device, and clearing app data replaces it.

Send feedback through the Android share sheet using an app of your choice. The prepared message carries only app version and environment, and never a session token, broker credentials, a chart image or execution secrets.
Production connectivity, provider whitelisting and live execution readiness are separate operational gates and are not implied by this screen.
